newsitem.title: CHINA: Changchai sees little change in H1 net.
newsitem.headline: Changchai sees little change in H1 net.

text.p: Chinese diesel engine maker Changchai Co Ltd expects its first-half 1997 net profit to be roughly equal to the January-June 1996 level of 126 million yuan, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

Profits were not expected to rise much in the period because increasing competition in China's diesel engine market had squeezed profit margins, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
He declined to give further details.
The Shenzhen-listed company posted net profit of 230.7 million yuan in 1996 against 203.1 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards.
Changchai, based in the eastern province of Jiangsu, mainly makes diesel engines for the agricultural sector.
